For the matrix $\begin{pmatrix} 3 & 5 \\ -4 & -4 \end{pmatrix}$, we have $a = 3$, $b = 5$, $c = -4$, and $d = -4$. So, the determinant is $(3)(-4) - (5)(-4)$.
